card.name: Mutation testing in oncology patient selection
card.fires_on: Words in cancer drug labels just before a gene mutation or biomarker is named, such as 'detected by', 'presence of', and digits inside EGFR variants like T790M. It is strongest in patient-selection text about FDA-approved tests.

modes.label: Linking words before a mutation
modes.description: Small words like 'by', 'of' and 'in' in phrases about detecting a mutation or biomarker.
modes.example: Select patients for treatment with TAGRISSO based on the presence of a mutation as detected<< by>> an FDA-approved test.

modes.label: Inside mutation or drug names
modes.description: Digits or pieces inside EGFR mutation names or kinase inhibitor names.
modes.example: TAGRISSO monotherapy EGFR T7<<9>>0M Mutation Plasma or tumor Information on

card.writes: It seems to push toward the word 'resistance', as in drug resistance mutations, though the other promoted tokens look like noise.
card.plain: It lights up where a cancer drug label is about to name a gene mutation that a test must find.
